title: Degree of a low degree Fourier projection
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb N$ and let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be a function on the Boolean cube. Every nonzero Fourier–Walsh coefficient of the Fourier truncation of $f$ to sets of size at most $k$ is indexed by a set of size at most $k$.
replaced: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube and $k\in\mathbb N$. The Fourier projection $f^{\le k}$ has Fourier degree at most $k$.
